title: gui: Onboarding report panel (Repo 101) — learn census + where to start
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md (F1) · exec plan: docs/v2-execution-plan.md · wave B3]
Seats: DSN-03, DSN-06, DOC-04
Gap found by the DOC-2 audit: the GUI block in v2-plan named crates/gui/src/onboard.rs but no card owned it. This card does.
Deliverable: crates/gui/src/onboard.rs — the 'Repo 101' panel shown after learn() completes, driven by LearnProgress + the cached Analysis/Index (no re-analysis): language mix, file/LOC/symbol census, entrypoints, the module tree (crate -> dir -> file) from core::modules::build, top hotspot files from core::complexity, unused-variable count, cycle count, and a suggested reading order (entrypoints first, then highest fan-in symbols — reuse core::tour where it fits). Every row clicks through to Text/Graph/Diagrams. Honest empty state when there is no analysis yet ('run Learn first'), and a visible 'still learning' state driven by LearnProgress.
Do not compute anything in the GUI that core already provides: read core::complexity::per_file / hotspots, core::modules::build, core::analysis. If a number is missing, show 'unknown' rather than guessing.
Owner: crates/gui/src/onboard.rs (+ the sidebar tab line the integrator wires). Depends: CORE-7 (learn), CORE-4 (complexity/modules).
Verify: cargo build -p repowalk-gui, clippy -D warnings, cargo test -p repowalk-gui; the displayed census equals the Analysis/Index contents on fixtures (spot-check numbers in the card evidence).

EVIDENCE (TL-DSN, 2026-10-15T23:49:51Z): crates/gui/src/onboard.rs delivered (only file touched; no app.rs/sidebar/ui_kit/theme/core edits).
Sections rendered: (1) What this is — LOC headline + "N files · M symbols · K entry points" + language mix (index.files[].lang); (2) How it is shaped — module tree from Analysis.modules/module_edges when populated, else an explicit "not populated" note + fallback top-level dirs from index.files; (3) Where the risk is — most-complex files (complexity::per_file), most-complex functions (complexity::hotspots), unused-variable count (complexity::unused_variables), import cycles (modules::cycles when the tree is populated, else metrics::compute().cycles); (4) Where to start — entrypoints first, then core::tour ranked order, each row clickable (Selection::File / Selection::Symbol / open_file_with(path,line)); (5) Status — learn phase + done/total from app.progress, or the cached analysis counts, or "press Learn". No core logic recomputed in the GUI; absent data shows "unknown"/fallback, never an invented number.
Real-repo census (cargo run -p repowalk-cli -- report --json -- .): 340 files · 46219 LOC · 1591 symbols · 32 entrypoints; language mix rust 110, json 91, markdown 70, yaml 33, toml 9, other 7, python 6, shell 4, html 3, css 1, javascript 1, jsonl 1, lock 1, mdc 1, orig 1, typescript 1. Risk: hot files crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs (total 272, max 41), rust.rs (249/26), ts.rs (247/20), crates/gui/src/app.rs (93/24), rules.rs (80/14); hot functions python.rs:605 cx41, tour.rs:17 cx37, highlighting.rs:110 cx30, rust.rs:563 cx26, app.rs:263 cx24; unused variables 402; import cycles 1 (Analysis.modules is empty — CORE-9 not wired — so the top-level-dir fallback + v1 cycles are shown).
Gates (real): cargo fmt -p repowalk-gui -- --check -> exit 0; cargo clippy -p repowalk-gui --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0 (Finished dev profile); cargo test -p repowalk-gui -> 44 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; the 5 onboard tests are green incl. real_learn_pipeline_feeds_the_census (learn() -> census/risk/cycles consistency). No new dependencies; no commit/push.
FOUND ADVERTISED BUT NOT IMPLEMENTED (reported, not fixed): learn() (crates/core/src/learn.rs) leaves Analysis.modules/module_edges empty (CORE-9 owns wiring modules::build), so the panel uses its documented fallback; and the GUI IndexProgress carries only phase/done/total, not learn()'s variables/cfgs/types/uses counts, so the in-flight Status line shows the phase and done/total while the running counts appear once learn finishes.
